proposals.content: Bilinear decomposition of the primitive Mobius-Mangoldt tail. Review confirms intended BV range with qualifications; Rankin exponents need correction, non-reduced residue Mobius BV step is not justified, exact R-3 identity omits minus Tbad. Type II and uniform HB+ are unproved. Never ingest original claims as verified overwrite.

Numerical class bias and finite Ramanujan model, known model in literature. Parseval equality must be inequality; moving boxes require a maximal argument supplied in 08. Original singular-series correlation used a stride sample confined to multiples of five; not a representative population correlation. Model residual is not automatically a continuous minor-arc integral.

Reproduced both experiments at 1e6 and extended to 1e7. No stable residual mean sign useful to establish uniform HB+. Full tail sampled at 25 even N per scale, all c included. New Lean file verifies finite reindexing, explicit proper-prime-power error (4.12), and first explicit bad-tail inequality of Prop.4.2, with only standard axioms. No Goldbach proof, asymptotic Type II bound, or independently reviewed written proof is asserted.

mathematical_status: Goldbach open. Numerical evidence and almost-all statements do not prove the universal conjecture.
